_comment: Near miss 2: skip the framework setting and parse the header by hand. Looks careful, is the spoofable half of the problem, and leaves every other reader of the address inconsistent.
culprit: The app reads the socket peer instead of the forwarded header, so it records ::1 behind the proxy.
evidence: The page line shows ::1 while the same peer pulled ten media clips and posted analytics, which only a browser does.
why_it_was_missed: Nothing errored; a well-formed loopback address was stored as if it were the visitor, so it silently looked like local traffic.

fix.ordering: in the analytics writer, before the insert

does_not_fix: It still cannot identify VPN or corporate NAT users.
